CHANGES
Combined unmodified modular ULPC artwork in its defined layer order.
Recolored male skin from ULPC light to ULPC green by exact official palette substitution.
Extracted source standing frames and nearest-neighbor enlarged previews.
Duplicated the original stationary walk frame into a static two-column compatibility sheet. No new pixels or equipment were drawn.

ANIMATION NOTE
The two-column idle-static sheet contains two copies of the same original standing frame, not a new animated idle cycle. The waraxe and round shield have original walk frames but no native idle layer. The complete 9-frame walk sheet is included.

The images are standalone exports only. They have not been added to any game or deployed.


ORC SLASH ATTACK ADDITION
Same pinned ULPC revision: 86a3719ee4a7e2e9fb27c7c152e29a741d3e930a
Selected license: CC-BY-SA 3.0. The same body, head, armor, round-shield and waraxe authors listed above apply to the corresponding original slash frames.
Exact source-layer paths, hashes and z-order are in attack-preset.json.
Changes: composite original slash layers, recolor body from ULPC light to ULPC green, losslessly center-crop oversized192x192 tiles to128x128. No new or redrawn weapon art.
Geometry: 768x512, six128x128 frames per direction, rows north/west/south/east. Original64x64 body tile begins at32,32 in each final frame.
